[{"source_id":"2.7","title":"Changing or extending your stay","text":"House manual > 2. Booking Rules, Fees and Policies > 2.7 Changing or extending your stay

- **Extending:** ask us. If the apartment is free for the extra nights we can usually extend at the same nightly rate. The host confirms every extension personally; it is not confirmed until the host says so.
- **Changing dates or moving to another apartment:** subject to availability and the host's approval.
- **Minimum and maximum stay:** the minimum is 1 night and the maximum is **28 nights** per booking. Longer stays are only possible with the host's approval.
- **Special rates and long-stay discounts:** we do not publish any. The host decides case by case."},{"source_id":"18","title":"Quick FAQ","text":"House manual > 18. Quick FAQ

**What time can I check in and out?** Check-in is from 2:00 PM and check-out is by 11:00 AM.

**Is there a cleaning fee?** No. It is included in the nightly rate.

**Can I drink the tap water?** No. Use the filtered RO dispenser in the kitchen.

**What happens in a power cut?** The generator starts in about 30 seconds. Lifts, lights, Wi-Fi, fridge and one AC keep running.

**Is smoking allowed?** Only in the marked corner of the roof terrace.

**Can friends visit?** Yes, between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM, up to 4 at a time, registered at Gate 2. No overnight visitors.

**Is there a washing machine?** Yes in the One-Bedroom, Two-Bedroom and Penthouse. Studio guests use the shared laundry room (PKR 400 per wash).

**Where do I park?** In the basement (B1) through Gate 1, one space per apartment (two for the Penthouse).

**What if I am locked out?** Call the host or the emergency maintenance line (section 13.4).

**Who can approve a refund or a special request?** Only the host (section 2.8)."},{"source_id":"14.3","title":"Late check-out","text":"House manual > 14. Checking Out > 14.3 Late check-out

Late check-out until **2:00 PM** costs **PKR 2,500**. It is only possible if no guest is arriving in your apartment that day, and it must be requested **by 9:00 PM the evening before**. The host confirms it. If you stay beyond 2:00 PM, a full night is charged at the nightly rate. You can leave your luggage at the front desk until 9:00 PM (section 3.6)."},{"source_id":"3.6","title":"Early check-in and luggage storage","text":"House manual > 3. Getting Here and Arriving > 3.6 Early check-in and luggage storage

- **Early check-in** is possible **from 12:00 PM** for **PKR 2,000**, but only if the apartment was empty the night before. Request it **at least 24 hours before arrival**. The host confirms by 10:00 AM on the day of arrival. Check-in before 12:00 PM is not possible because the apartment is being cleaned.
- **Luggage storage** is free at the front desk before check-in and after check-out, between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM. Please do not leave valuables, passports or cash. Outside front desk hours, ask the security desk; luggage is left at your own risk."}]
